newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chinese dissident wins 1996 Sakharov prize.
newsitem.headline: Chinese dissident wins 1996 Sakharov prize.

text.p: Wei Jingsheng, one of China's leading dissidents, has been awarded the 1996 Sakharov prize for freedom of thought, the European Parliament announced on Thursday.
Wei Jingsheng has spent most of the last two decades in prison for his outspoken comments on human rights and political issues. Last December he was given a 14-year sentence.
The 15,000 Ecu prize will be awarded at a ceremony in the European Parliament in Strasbourg in December.
Former winners of the prize, instituted in 1985 as a tribute to Soviet dissident Andrei Sakharov, include South African President Nelson Mandela and Burmese opposiiton leader Aung San Suu Kyi.
